Name: LMMM's Simple Bathroom
Author: LittleMissMementoMori
Description:
[size=5][u]Description
[/u][/size][size=3]Want a separate bathroom to hide from your spouse and kids because they drive you mad? Well, now you can! Introducing, my Simple Bathroom Mod! Plop down a door and do whatever you want in there... I ain't judging. Want to take a bath? Go for it! Want to just stare at your non-reflective self in the mirror and contemplate about the meaning of your existence in this 3-dimensional plane (Well... I guess it's 2D)? I know you do! What are you waiting for? Get this handy dandy simple bathroom and fill it up with whatever you want!

[spoiler]You can even refill your watering can with your bathtub! Because who does not want to water their plants with gamer girl/boy water?![/spoiler][/size]
[url=https://ibb.co/cLxvWtz][img]https://i.ibb.co/vYDBNm2/base.png[/img]
[/url]
[url=https://ibb.co/PgcY9yG][img]https://i.ibb.co/QMPcCVv/basewwallfloor.png[/img][/url]
[size=5][u]Download Instructions
[/u][/size]1. Make sure you have [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Indoor Farm[/url] installed into your mods folder (Shoutout to both creators, would not have done this without you)
2. Download the .rar
3. Move the .rar into your mods folder and extract

[size=5][u]How to Get Your Bathroom
[/u][/size]1. Have at least 1000 gold
2. Go to Robin's carpentry shop and buy a Dimensional Door
[url=https://ibb.co/mbJ6Rgj][img]https://i.ibb.co/Dz451TJ/dimdoorshop.png[/img][/url]
3. Place the door on a wall in your farmhouse
4. Right-click to select the room you desire (I sure hope it's my bathroom, because that's why you're here... right?)
5. Right-click the door to enter
6. Sit there.
[u][url=https://ibb.co/9T8tnxZ][img]https://i.ibb.co/4TmdWb1/preview.png[/img][/url][/u]
